text: The compaction abort test snapshots the direct parent directory before and after the abort and checks both Set differences. One direction catches leaked names; the other catches lost names. It also checks unchanged mailbox size and expunged-byte state. For this cleanup test, retain both comparisons instead of checking only that a known temporary filename is absent. This tests direct directory-entry names, not recursive contents or file-byte equality. No abort or filesystem test was executed in this study. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Abort tests compare directory names in both directions
